items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Tony Perrini gets a big fat tone. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, bang. Tony, he plays a BAME.

ctx.x: Yeah, but still I've heard Benny Goodman when you don't have a microphone sometime and it doesn't come through like when he's up close to the mic. Is that right?
It sounds big too. Uh-huh. Tony Perrini gets a big fat tone. He gets a fat tone, yeah.
Oh, bang. Tony, he plays a BAME.
